description: A labelled action (DESIGN.md, Button): a pill ButtonSize.height tall that grows with the text (up to block's full width). loading replaces icon with a spinner (or shows it before the label when there is no icon), keeps the button's width — the label ellipsizes if it must — and ignores presses.

params.name: label
params.description: The button's one-line label; ellipsized if it must.

params.name: onPressed
params.description: Called on a press; null, or while loading, disables it.

params.name: icon
params.description: Before the label, TsuyaSpace.s8 away; replaced by a spinner while loading.

params.name: block
params.description: Grows to fill the width it is given.

params.name: loading
params.description: Shows a spinner, keeps the width, and ignores presses.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses it as soon as it is built.
